output:
cat > pdb.yaml << 'EOF'
apiVersion: policy/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: myapp-pdb
spec:
  minAvailable: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: myapp
EOF
kubectl apply -f pdb.yaml

cat > priority.yaml << 'EOF'
apiVersion: scheduling.k8s.io/v1
kind: PriorityClass
metadata:
  name: high-priority
value: 1000
globalDefault: false
description: High priority pods
EOF
kubectl apply -f priority.yaml

instruction: Use a PersistentVolumeClaim in a pod
output:
cat > pvc-pod.yaml << 'EOF'
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: mypod
spec:
  containers:
  - name: myapp
    image: nginx
    volumeMounts:
    - name: data
      mountPath: /data
  volumes:
  - name: data
    persistentVolumeClaim:
      claimName: mypvc
EOF
kubectl apply -f pvc-pod.yaml

cat > storageclass.yaml << 'EOF'
apiVersion: storage.k8s.io/v1
kind: StorageClass
metadata:
  name: fast-store
provisioner: kubernetes.io/aws-ebs
parameters:
  type: gp3
reclaimPolicy: Retain
EOF
kubectl apply -f storageclass.yaml

instruction: Enable Istio sidecar injection for namespace

output:
cat > vs.yaml << 'EOF'
apiVersion: networking.istio.io/v1beta1
kind: VirtualService
metadata:
  name: myapp-vs
spec:
  hosts:
  - myapp
  http:
  - route:
    - destination:
        host: myapp
        subset: v1
EOF
kubectl apply -f vs.yaml

kubectl apply -f - << 'EOF'
apiVersion: networking.istio.io/v1beta1
kind: DestinationRule
metadata:
  name: myapp-dr
spec:
  host: myapp
  subsets:
  - name: v1
    labels:
      version: v1
  - name: v2
    labels:
      version: v2
EOF

kubectl apply -f - << 'EOF'
apiVersion: networking.istio.io/v1beta1
kind: Gateway
metadata:
  name: mygateway
spec:
  selector:
    istio: ingressgateway
  servers:
  - port:
      number: 80
      name: http
      protocol: HTTP
    hosts:
    - "*"
EOF
